name: LoudVideos
author: pali (pali#0439)
short: Sends a warning message when a video is too loud.
description: Sends a warning message when a video is too loud.
install_msg: This bot will now warn when a video that is too loud gets posted. Please install `ffmpeg` on your system if it is not installed already.
end_user_data_statement: This cog temporarily downloads videos linked in Discord messages for analysis but does not persistently store user data.
